subject: English
passage: What makes the hoverboard such an intriguing transportation device? You control it using only body movement. When you place your ______ the speed will change as your feet shift position.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation:
Choice B is the best answer. The convention being tested is the use of plural nouns in a sentence. The plural noun "feet" and the plural noun "sensors" correctly indicate that two feet are placed on two sensors when riding the hoverboard.

Why D is incorrect:

Choice D is incorrect because the context requires the plural noun "feet," not the plural possessive noun "feet'."
